# Retimed complex supplier for a future p10 successor

The exact complex coarse saving with the complete bad-class fallback is
`b = 772881996923825/10^18`, improved from PR315's `772714351296671/10^18`.
This package makes **no new κ claim**. It supplies a stronger independently admitted complex input for a new combined construction. The supplier is prepared for composition with a
future independently admitted bit word in a new pull request.

The construction splits grouped additions into their unchanged scalar sequence,
then retimes 29 individual gates and 69 exact same-frame incidence components. It continues through 50 downward and 672 upward component edits; histogram-preserving neutral changes expose 24 additional strict changes.
Every scalar coefficient, order, port, scatter source, scatter coefficient and
start/final frame is preserved. Retiming lowers the complete five-stage paid
call count from 351,820 to 351,655 at unchanged rank mass 1,571,680, live stock
14,316 and deficit 3,080. The largest child remains rank 46.

Run with Python 3.11 or newer, entirely offline:

```sh
python3 -B verify.py --output /tmp/complex-supplier-proof
```

Use a fresh output directory outside this package. The verifier binds every
input with `MANIFEST.json`, regenerates all four retiming stages, checks the frozen
selections and final program hash, and runs all checks fresh. The final expanded
gcert SHA256 is `ea52d07910dca90871c2cd928894f491e305fa10edabd2f220cb45f0648e61a5`.
No saved PASS receipt is used as an input.

Admission includes both Sussman scalar/label checkers and flipped-sign controls,
both reflected scalar/frame splices, all paid climbs and copied-centre children,
temporary lifetimes, the complete finite invoice and row/precision guards, and
two independent exact rational moment engines. Both engines reject the adjacent
`10^-18` grid point, with and without the fallback. The scalar programs including
dirty-response and cleanup words match PR315 exactly. Their real-component
primitive bills remain 1,735,572 forward and 1,789,788 backward.

This remains conditional on the inherited dirty-lifting, exact frame geometry,
cover, fixed-tape compilation, routing, precision/recovery and analytic-transfer
interfaces. There is no new Lean run, unconditional multiplication theorem or
runtime benchmark. See `PROOF.md` and `NOTICE.md`.
